visual_enhancers.shadows: Use very subtle shadows `shadow-sm` or crisp 1px borders instead of large blurry drop shadows to maintain sterile financial accuracy.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E4E4E7 on all cards and tables.
visual_enhancers.radius: Minimal. Use `rounded-md` (6px) or `rounded-sm` (4px). Avoid fully rounded pills unless for badges.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid on financial dashboards (data needs solid backgrounds). Allowed only on Marketing Page sticky nav.

layouts.app_shell: CSS Grid based sidebar layout. Left Sidebar fixed 260px width, right main content area taking 1fr. Sidebar background white with 1px right border. Main area background zinc-50.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento-style or high-density Grid. `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6`.
layouts.marketing_container: Max width 1200px, heavily padded `px-6 py-24 md:py-32`.
layouts.auth_layout: Centered card `max-w-md` surrounded by a subtle dotted or noise background. Card p-8 with crisp border.

Landing_Page.instructions: High contrast hero. Deep Navy background with white text. Use `Manrope` for big impact. Focus on Indian Shopify D2C.

Auth_Flow.Register: Form with Name, Email, Password. Below password, show a 4-item checklist for password rules (12+ chars, upper/lower, number, special) with Check/X icons.
Auth_Flow.Login: Email, Password. Show error alert styling for 'Lockout after 5 failed attempts'.
Auth_Flow.Verification: A simple 'Check your email' screen with an envelope icon.

App_Shell.Sidebar: Workspace Switcher at top (dropdown). Links: Dashboard, Reconciliation, Reports, Settings. Bottom: User Profile.
App_Shell.Topbar: Breadcrumbs, active period selector, Help, Notifications.

Workspace_Settings.General: Form for Workspace Name, Timezone (select), Currency (INR default).
Workspace_Settings.Tolerances: Inputs for 'Amount mismatch threshold' and 'Refund mismatch threshold'.

Members_and_Roles.Members_Table: Columns: User, Role, Status, Actions. Badges for roles.
Members_and_Roles.Invite_Dialog: Email input and Role select. Uses Shadcn Dialog.
Members_and_Roles.Roles_Matrix: Table where rows are permissions (e.g., View Data, Export, Invite Users) and columns are roles (Owner, Admin, Viewer) with Check/Dash icons.

Active_Sessions.layout: List of sessions showing Browser, OS, IP, Location, Time. Button to 'Revoke' per row, and 'Revoke All' at top.

components_usage.buttons: Primary: Deep Navy (`bg-[#0A0F2C] hover:bg-[#1E293B] text-white`). Flat, no shadow, `rounded-md`.
components_usage.tables: Shadcn Table. Header `bg-zinc-50/50`. Tabular figures for all numeric cells.
components_usage.forms: Left-aligned labels. Explicit error messages below fields. Red border on error.
components_usage.badges: Square-ish with subtle background and strong text. e.g. `bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800`.

marketing_hero.description: Graphs on a screen representing financial data

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Create depth via clean borders and whitespace.
Never apply `transition: all`. Use specific transitions like `transition-colors`.
DO NOT center align the root `.App` container. Rely on flex/grid for alignment.
DO NOT use AI emoji characters for icons. ALWAYS use lucide-react.
All interactive elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-btn"`).
Maintain high contrast. Finance users need clarity, not soft low-contrast grey-on-grey.
Use standard plain JavaScript (.js/.jsx files), NO TypeScript.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in headers, overlays, or any surface with content underneath it.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio. Text colors must be distinct.
